true_answer: For a function f : N → N , a recursive definition consists of an initial condition together with a recurrence relation . The initial condition is the explicitly given value of f ( 0 ) . The recurrence re- lation is a formula for f ( n + 1 ) in terms for f ( n ) (and possibly n itself). Example 0.4.5 Give recursive definitions for the functions described below. 1. f : N → N gives the number of snails in your terrarium n years after you built it, assuming you started with 3 snails and the number of snails doubles each year. 2.
